## Core Project Experience

### Full-Stack Web Applications
Designed and built production-ready applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and modern SQL/NoSQL databases with clean architecture, authentication, and performance optimization.

### Business & Platform Development
Developed recruitment systems, educational platforms, portfolio sites, content management tools, and business dashboards with secure backends and polished user experiences.

### AI-Powered Applications
Integrated large language models (LLMs), document processing, intelligent search, resume tools, AI assistants, and workflow automation into real-world web applications.

### API & Database Engineering
Designed secure RESTful APIs, implemented robust authentication systems, managed relational and NoSQL databases, optimized queries, and built scalable backend services.

### Web3 Development
Built decentralized applications (dApps), integrated wallets, developed Solidity smart contracts (including customizable BEP-20 tokens), and worked with Ethereum-compatible tooling such as Foundry and Hardhat.
